repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## Ruled · 2026-11-24T18:58Z · not planned — tasks reach users through the app menu

**The maintainer's words**, in seat repo:objectstack#4's session, 2026-11-24, verbatim: 「B」 — the answer to the seat's presentation of this card's conflict, analysed at fable tier, with option A (an inbox "Tasks" tab) and option B (retire this card; tasks are reached through the app menu).

Why the card cannot be built as written: the maintainer's ruling of 2026-11-23 on #36107 (comment 7104152823: the platform home page is retired; the sidebar bell is the single to-do and notification entry) left the home page's 「我的工作」 area reachable only by a user with no app — desktop `/home` redirects into an app (`ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx:213-222`), and the phone home lists apps only (`HomePage.tsx:746`). A block there would pass its tests and be seen by almost nobody.

Ruled B: no new surface. A user reaches their tasks through the app menu — the starter app (#36944) carries `sys_task` in its menu, and #36942 ships the `assigned_to_me` list view. Known and accepted with the ruling: a user with only another app installed has no task entry, and an assignment sends no notification today.

Closed as not planned by this ruling.

Closed as not planned · 2026-11-24T19:01Z · by the ruling recorded just above (the maintainer: 「B」).
